neighbours.label: Navigation-control infrastructure for aircraft and ships (airport, control tower, ground control, harbour beacons), vs other transport places
fire: Our cousins picked us up at the airport just after midnight.
The plane waited on the runway until the control tower gave permission.
飞机降落后，我们在机场的出口等出租车。
In thick fog, the pilot relied on ground control to find the runway.
Ships entering the bay follow the beacons and channel markers.
The new airport terminal has forty gates and two runways.
Air traffic controllers in the tower guided the jet to the gate.
The lighthouse and the foghorn warn ships away from the reef.
quiet: Our cousins picked us up at the bus depot just after midnight.
The train waited on the platform until the conductor gave permission.
火车到站后，我们在车站的出口等出租车。
In thick fog, the hikers relied on a compass to find the trail.
Swimmers entering the bay follow the lifeguard and the flags.
The new shopping mall has forty shops and two cinemas.
Ticket inspectors on the train guided the family to their seats.
The museum and the library close early on public holidays.

predictions: Airport/tower/beacon nouns 0.35-0.55; train stations, bus depots, sports officials under 0.15.
notes: Card: ' airport' x6, ' Airport' x5, 港/机场 x5, ground control, control tower, harbour navigation facility (foghorn, beacon).
